entries.description: Collision, acceleration, flight-layer movement, and terrain traversal require controlled emulator traces.

The complete-sheet path compiles source-pinned weapon timing, hit/defense, centered damage, resistance, and proc mechanics; current WonderBane sheet inputs and differential traces are still required for deployment parity.

The complete-sheet path applies source-pinned power hit, stat/focus scaling, centered rolls, resistance, and train semantics to the archived Shadow Bolt row; the current WonderBane row and differential distribution remain unverified.
Stun and immunity stack precedence must be checked against authoritative effect-stack traces.

The complete-sheet path applies source-pinned stat/focus scaling, centered rolls, healing resistance, and train semantics to the archived Psychic Healing row; the current WonderBane row and differential distribution remain unverified.
Passwall remains non-executable pending ground-target, terrain, invisibility, and damage-interrupt semantics.

The runtime represents normal, offensive, defensive, precise, and travel as one exclusive state and drops travel on an unavoided hit; current stance modifiers and immune-hit edge behavior require controlled WonderBane traces.

Caster- and target-centered radius execution is implemented with relation filters, deterministic caps, and per-victim hit gates; current per-power origin, radius, cap, line-of-sight, and avoidance rows require authoritative traces.

The sourced direct poison hit, six five-second pulses, focus scaling, and refresh behavior require a controlled current-WonderBane trace; snare magnitude and stack precedence require the corresponding movement trace.

The pinned Psychic Shield table uses a 1000-point post-resistance breakpoint while later MagicBane patch history reports 750; a current WonderBane trace must resolve the threshold, resistance application, and stack precedence.
